name: Grottaglie (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Grottaglie (a bull in a cave beneath a star on blue) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI GROTTAGLIE in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Grottaglie, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Grottaglie arms — bull in a cave beneath a star on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI GROTTAGLIE arched above the arms
